title: Final Gibbs Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that g_l = g_g for equilibrium between phases.

title: Clausius-Clapeyron Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must express dP/dT in terms of s_l, s_g, v_l, and v_g.

title: Triple Point Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final values for T and P at the triple point of ammonia.

title: Thermodynamic Principles
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the thermodynamic principles leading to ΔG = 0 clearly.

title: Chemical Potential Changes
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss how chemical potentials change with temperature and pressure.

title: Heat Transfer Understanding
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the role of heat transfer in maintaining temperature during phase changes.

title: Ideal Gas Assumption
description: Optional Criteria: The student may note the assumption that the vapor behaves as an ideal gas.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of relationships between g_l and g_g.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.
